title: Meta, Google DeepMind, and Isomorphic Labs invest $300M and the US invests $500M+ in Zuckerberg-backed Biohub to build open biology datasets for AI training (Krystal Hu/Reuters)
commentary: Google, Meta, the US government, and drug-discovery AI in one deal — $1.8B to build open biology datasets is less about altruism and more about who controls the training data layer for the next decade of biomedical AI.
